title: Cast Your Burden on the Lord

questions.question: Give ear to my prayer, O God, and hide not yourself from my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:1 (ESV): "Give ear to my prayer, O God, and hide not yourself from my plea for mercy!"

questions.question: Attend to me, and answer me; I am restless in my complaint and I do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:2 (ESV): "...I am restless in my complaint and I moan,"

questions.question: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of what have fallen upon me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:4 (ESV): "...the terrors of death have fallen upon me."

questions.question: Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror does what to me?
And I say, "Oh, that I had wings like a what? I would fly away and be at rest."
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:6 (ESV): "And I say, 'Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest;'"

questions.question: I would hurry to find a shelter from the raging wind and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:8 (ESV): "I would hurry to find a shelter from the raging wind and tempest."

questions.question: Destroy, O Lord, divide their tongues; for I see violence and strife in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:9 (ESV): "...for I see violence and strife in the city."

questions.question: But it is you, a man, my equal, my companion, my familiar what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:13 (ESV): "But it is you, a man, my equal, my companion, my familiar friend."

questions.question: We used to take sweet counsel together; within God's house we walked in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:14 (ESV): "...within God's house we walked in the throng."

questions.question: But I call to God, and the Lord will what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:16 (ESV): "But I call to God, and the Lord will save me."

questions.question: Evening and morning and at noon I utter my complaint and moan, and he hears my what?
He redeems my soul in safety from the battle that I wage, for many are arrayed against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:18 (ESV): "...for many are arrayed against me."

questions.question: My companion stretched out his hand against his friends; he violated his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:20 (ESV): "My companion stretched out his hand against his friends; he violated his covenant."

questions.question: His speech was smooth as butter, yet war was in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:21 (ESV): "His speech was smooth as butter, yet war was in his heart;"

questions.question: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 55:22 (ESV): "...he will never permit the righteous to be moved."

key_verse_text: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.
